reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is exactly what a compliant finding should look like.

The cited text supports compliance: §2 creates an evergreen term terminable only under §6, and §6(a) gives either party (including us) an at-will 15-day exit when no SOW is outstanding — there is no automatic renewal term, no non-renewal notice window, and no multi-year auto-renewal walk-away risk. Continuation is effectively SOW-by-SOW mutual agreement, matching the preferred position.
Deterministic check (notice window = 15 days ≤ 60) corroborates the assessment.

The uncapped unilateral rate-change right in §3(b) is correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged here, avoiding double-counting a pricing term that belongs to the fees/price-increase rule; the rationale accurately explains why its impact is limited given the 15-day exit.
